findings.one_line: The main moving-row QTE claim is only positioned against Avella-Medina--Davis--Samorodnitsky, Hirano--Imbens--Ridder, Firpo, and Heiler--Kazak; the bibliography/comparator set supplies no relevance-and-theorem-level comparison for Ma--Wang, Khan--Tamer, Knight, Politis--Romano--Wolf, Dorn, or Sant'Anna--Song--Xu, so the asserted frontier gap is not yet adequately supported.

The claimed refutation of raw scalar subsampling names neither a specific published estimator/workflow nor its cited guarantee (bibkey plus claim); identify that target and delimit the counterexample to its stated scope, or present the construction only as an internal diagnostic rather than a novelty claim.
